raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to identify and extract independent, credible sources beyond Wikipedia and IMDb when tasked to confirm Anne Gadegaard’s birthplace. Instead, it relied primarily on the same sources (Wikipedia and IMDb) repeatedly, which were already flagged for inconsistencies in their birthplace data (Århus vs. Copenhagen). This failure to diversify sources and verify the information through additional credible references led to an ambiguous and inconclusive answer to the real-world problem.
